_comment: API routes that no screen is meant to call: they serve other programs, links in emails, or sign-in itself. Each pattern needs a reason. `/**` matches everything beneath a path.

routes./api/v1/**: The public REST API, called with an API key.
routes./api/mcp: The MCP server endpoint, called by MCP clients.
routes./api/oauth/**: OAuth for MCP clients: discovery, registration, token exchange.
routes./api/auth/[...nextauth]: NextAuth's own handler, reached through its client library.
routes./api/t/**: Open and click tracking and the unsubscribe page, reached from links inside sent emails.
routes./api/health: Liveness and readiness probe for the container platform.
routes./api/inbox: The reply list in the shape it had before conversations. The inbox screen reads /api/conversations; this is kept for the MCP tool inbox_list and for scripts written against it.
routes./api/inbox/reply: Send an email by address without naming a conversation. Kept for the MCP tool inbox_send_email; the screen sends through /api/conversations/[id]/send.
routes./api/inbox/thread: A contact's email thread in the shape it had when it was read from the mailbox. Kept for the MCP tool reply_intelligence_manage; the screen reads /api/conversations/[id].
routes./api/inbox/sync: Start or report a mailbox check alone. Kept for the MCP tool reply_intelligence_manage; the screen uses /api/conversations/sync, which also asks for the LinkedIn inboxes.
routes./api/inbox/reclassify-all: Read every reply that has no verdict yet, in bulk. An operator's tool, reached through the MCP tool reply_intelligence_manage.
routes./api/inbox/backfill: An older name for /api/inbox/reclassify-all, kept so calls written against it still work.
routes./api/runs: List runs and start one by naming a campaign, list and senders. The screens launch through /api/workflows/[id]/launch; this is kept for the MCP tools runs_list and run_create and for the public API.
routes./api/runs/[id]: Read one run with its log, change its status, delete it. The screens pause and resume through /api/workflows/bulk and read /api/workflows/[id]/prospects and /log; kept for the MCP tools run_get and run_control.
routes./api/runs/[id]/start: Start one run. Kept for the MCP tool run_control; the screens launch and resume by campaign.
routes./api/runs/[id]/accounts: The LinkedIn accounts of one run. The Settings tab changes them through /api/workflows/[id]/settings; kept for the MCP tool run_control.
routes./api/runs/[id]/retry: Retry failed prospects of one run by contact id. The Prospects tab acts across a campaign's runs through /api/workflows/[id]/prospects; kept for the MCP tool run_membership_manage.
routes./api/runs/[id]/unenroll: Unenrol one contact from one run. Kept for the MCP tool run_membership_manage; the Prospects tab uses /api/workflows/[id]/prospects.
routes./api/runs/[id]/remove: Remove contacts from one run. Kept for the MCP tool run_membership_manage; the Prospects tab uses /api/workflows/[id]/prospects.
routes./api/workflows/[id]/analytics: A campaign's analytics in the shape they had before the Overview tab: funnel, audience, engagement, activity, AI use and A/B versions over a named period. The Overview reads /api/workflows/[id]/overview; this is kept for the MCP tool workflow_analytics and is what the analytics CSV is made from.
routes./api/workflows/[id]/stats: A campaign's counts in the shape the old page read. Kept for the MCP tool workflow_advanced_manage (action stats).
routes./api/workflows/[id]/enrollments: A campaign's runs with their counts. The Prospects tab gets the same from /api/workflows/[id]/prospects; kept for the MCP tool workflow_advanced_manage (action enrollments).
routes./api/workflows/[id]/sequence: The published sequence with who stands on each step, and its track switches. The builder reads /api/workflows/[id]/builder; kept for the MCP tool workflow_advanced_manage (actions sequence and sequence_settings).
routes./api/workflows/[id]/steps: Read or replace a campaign's steps in one call. The builder saves a draft and publishes it; kept for the MCP tools workflow_get and workflow_add_step and for the public API.
routes./api/workflows/[id]/steps/[stepId]: Change, move or delete one step. Kept for the MCP tool workflow_advanced_manage (update_step, delete_step); the builder publishes whole sequences.
routes./api/workflows/[id]/duplicate: Copy one campaign. The campaigns list duplicates through /api/workflows/bulk; kept for the MCP tool workflow_advanced_manage (action duplicate).
routes./api/workflows/preview: Render one message for one contact from text given in the call. The builder previews a whole sequence through /api/workflows/[id]/preview; kept for the MCP tool outreach_preview.
routes./api/platform/workflow-branches: Conditional branches in the shape they had before gates. The builder edits gates as part of the sequence it publishes; kept for the MCP tool workflow_branch_manage.
routes./api/lists/[id]/conflicts: Which of a list's contacts are part-way through another campaign. The wizard asks /api/workflows/[id]/prelaunch, which also knows the campaign; kept for the MCP tool list_advanced_manage.
routes./api/email-health: Kept for the MCP tool email_health and for API callers. The Deliverability screen reads /api/deliverability.
routes./api/platform/settings: Kept for the MCP application-settings tool. The Mailboxes screen changes the same switches through /api/email-accounts/settings.
routes./api/alerts: What needs attention right now, by itself. The dashboard gets the same list inside /api/dashboard/overview; this is for API callers and anything that wants only the alerts.
routes./api/dashboard/stats: The dashboard's totals in the shape they had before the rebuilt dashboard: all-time counts read from the run log. The screen reads /api/dashboard/overview; this is kept for the MCP tool system_overview.
routes./api/dashboard/agent-stats: AI spend and tokens by day. The AI & models screen reads /api/ai/overview; this is kept for the MCP tool ai_usage_analytics.
routes./api/premium-status: Which optional parts of the product this build includes. The app frame gets the same from /api/shell; this is kept for the MCP tool system_overview.
routes./api/platform/calendar-oauth/[provider]/: Where Google or Microsoft sends the browser back after a member signs in to their calendar. The screen starts the sign-in with a link to /api/platform/calendar-oauth/[provider]/start; nothing in the app calls this one.
